name: qa-serverless
description: Serverless platform testing: AWS SAM Local, Azure Functions, .NET Lambda Test Tools, Cloudflare Workers Miniflare, Vercel Edge Runtime, Netlify Functions, Serverless Framework, plus cold-start + timeout budget references, a serverless integration-test builder, and the serverless-cold-start-critic agent. Covers Lambda / Workers / Edge runtimes which have specific testing patterns (cold-start budgets, timeout testing, local emulators, edge-runtime divergence) absent from generic web-server test plugins.
